conviction_note: Q3 numbers are new: no trading update, no profit warning, no guidance (Mips gives only long-term targets). abs_move is set from Mips's own reactions on its actual report dates (median 8.2%, with 26-28% tails) and a crowded 9.5% short that is still building. p_up is 57 because the only directional evidence is an inference from the company's own Q2 two-year organic stack, which puts Q3 sales about 5% above the 216 MSEK FactSet bar. That lean is tempered by the +8.6% 20-day run-up and by a bar that was already raised after the Q2 beat. impact_sum (+2.9) is larger than the scaled +1.19 because the findings are sized one by one and p_up carries the doubt that the beat is still unpriced.

findings.finding: On the company's own numbers the 216 MSEK sales bar looks beatable by about 5%. Applying Q2 2026's two-year organic stack (Q2 2025 +12% x Q2 2026 +42% = 1.59) to Q3's base (Q3 2025 organic +19%) gives Q3 organic of about +34%, or about 180 MSEK. Adding ~4% USD/SEK translation (USD/SEK ~9.6-10.0 in Q3 2026 against ~9.4-9.5 in Q3 2025; Q2 had zero FX effect) and ~40 MSEK of Koroyd (30pp of growth in Q2) gives about 225-230 MSEK. Q3 2025 snow was also depressed by customer order phasing, an easy comp.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sales beats on actual report dates: Q2 2026 (232 vs 214 consensus) +27.8%; Q1 2026 +8.7%; Q3 2025 ('över förväntan') +11.2%. Q4 2025, a profit miss, -5.6%; Q1 2025 -7.7%. Börsvärlden's table and Yahoo closes on MFN report dates.
findings.original_quote: 'Nettoomsättningen ökade med 72% till 232 MSEK (135), den organiska tillväxten uppgick till 42% under kvartalet' (net sales rose 72% to 232 MSEK, organic growth 42%). Q3 2025 report (https://mfn.se/a/mips/mips-kv3-delarsrapport-januari-september-2025): 'Nettoomsättningen ökade med 10% till 135 MSEK (123), den organiska tillväxten uppgick till 19%' and 'en något negativ utveckling inom underkategorin snö, beroende på fasning av orderläggning från en del större kunder' (somewhat negative development in snow due to the phasing of orders from some larger customers).
findings.why_not_priced: If the market held ~228 MSEK, FactSet would read above Q2's 232 MSEK, not 216, since Q3 has matched Q2 in past years (2025: 135 and 135). A 216 bar implies organic growth slowing to ~25%. The stock (407) is still 7% below its 28 July post-Q2 high of 439.8, and 60-day run-up is -7.0%, so the Q2 momentum has not been fully extrapolated. Six analysts in the $1-5m turnover band. This is an inference, not a disclosed number, hence p_up is only modestly above 50.
findings.independence: The FX leg is independent: Yahoo USD/SEK monthly series https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/SEK=X?range=2y&interval=1mo . Industry proxies point the other way (see the bike-OEM finding).

findings.finding: Q3 should be the last quarter carrying US litigation cost, and only as the known USD 3.25m (~31-32 MSEK) settlement. The run-rate legal costs that weighed on reported EBIT (13 MSEK in Q3 2025, 12 MSEK in Q2 2026) stop: management said on the Q2 call there are no extraordinary expenses in Q3 apart from the settlement. With a 58 MSEK EBIT bar that most likely includes the settlement, underlying EBIT is about 90 MSEK, below Q2's adjusted 108 on similar sales.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: EBIT fell 44 vs 48 'helt förklaras av legala kostnader och negativ påverkan av valutaförändringar' (entirely explained by legal costs and FX), and the stock still rose 11.2% on growth. Legal costs have not driven the reaction on their own.
findings.original_quote: 'Legala kostnader relaterat till den patenttvist som Mips valt att vara involverad i uppgick till 12 MSEK (14).' / 'Mips kommer att betala 3,25 MUSD som en del av förlikningen, vilket kommer att redovisas under tredje kvartalet 2026.' (Legal costs for the patent dispute were 12 MSEK (14). Mips will pay USD 3.25m as part of the settlement, recognised in Q3 2026.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the settlement is public. What is open is whether the 58 MSEK bar is reported or adjusted. If it is reported, the underlying margin implied (~41%) sits below Q2's 46.7% adjusted margin with the legal-cost drag removed, which leaves room for an EBIT beat. Capped small because the bar's treatment is unsourced.
findings.independence: Quartr Q2 2026 summary: 'No extraordinary expenses expected in Q3 aside from legal settlement.' https://quartr.com/events/mips-mips-q2-2026_3ewWKwoa

baseline_tension: Agrees with the priced lean (+2.37, squeeze-driven) and partly with the +8.6% 20-day run-up. The finding that adds to them is the company-level growth arithmetic; the run-up and the already-raised bar are why p_up stays at 57.
language_note: The Swedish Q3 2025 report carried the snow order-phasing remark ('fasning av orderläggning från en del större kunder') that makes the Q3 comp easy. The English summaries searched did not carry it, though the English release likely says the same.

The Q3 FactSet consensus (216 MSEK sales / 58 MSEK EBIT, six estimates) and the issuer's own reaction table came only from Swedish Finwire copy (Börsvärlden). English searches found no Q3 consensus at all.
The FI short register per-holder history (Marshall Wace and Wellington building) is a Swedish-language regulator page; the English wire carried none of it.
Mips publishes in both languages, so the filings themselves added nothing language-specific.
lessons_applied: 'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus the run-up: p_up 58 -> 57; finding sizes unchanged on that account
'A beat made of a one-off is sold' / a one-off at a fraction of operating money: legal-cost finding +0.5 -> +0.4
'Size the move on what is new; let history move p_up, not abs_move': abs_move kept at 8.5 (numbers are new, no pre-release), not cut to the baseline's 4.21
'Positioning is the thing to beat': the crowded, building short kept as fuel on the long side at a small size, since the baseline lean already counts the squeeze
